$comment: The engagement overlay: the plan DAG and delivery records a client engagement runs on — RAID, stakeholders, mirrored issues, dependencies, action items, user stories, spec nodes, deliverables, roadmap items — plus the work-graph edges (depends_on, derives_from). Composed as core + engagement this reproduces the template's original single-profile ontology. It also REFINES core: `patches` and `edgePatches` restore the engagement meaning of purpose-neutral core kinds and edges (a session is a meeting/recording analysed by the PlanOpticon pipeline; the activity feed is a rolling Git projection; contains is the phase > epic > feature > story hierarchy; owns, escalates_to and affiliated_with name stakeholders, deliverables and RAID items), and `contextRecipes.default` replaces core's identity-only traversal with the plan-DAG task-pack traversal (#204).

kinds.title: RAID Item
kinds.description: Risk / assumption / issue / dependency register entry; escalation channel alongside open questions.

kinds.title: Stakeholder
kinds.description: A person or group with a role in the engagement; owns decisions, questions, and work.

kinds.title: Issue
kinds.description: Committed snapshot of the external issue tracker (make issues); history in app/issues-history.json.

kinds.title: Dependency
kinds.description: Dependency edges across the plan, derived from the specs tree; the work graph's edge list.

kinds.title: Action Item
kinds.description: Executable follow-up extracted from sessions; the smallest dispatchable unit besides a story.

kinds.title: User Story
kinds.description: A story with acceptance criteria; work-class and dispatchable under #55.

kinds.title: Spec Node
kinds.description: A node of the plan tree (phase > epic > feature > story). The work graph's node set; stories are the dispatch unit.

kinds.title: Deliverable
kinds.description: A committed output with status; closing work nodes moves deliverables.

kinds.title: Roadmap Item
kinds.description: Strategy-cadence work. Owned by the slow loop: fast-tier agents escalate to it, never edit it (#55).

edges.description: Work-graph ordering: source cannot complete before target.
A work node's provenance to the decision or open question it cites (a story's references: frontmatter -> gen-brain.py's record_links linker, #55).
A work node has this immediate parent in the plan DAG.
Readiness evidence that this work node is blocked by another work node.
Consecutive work nodes on the computed critical dependency path.

memory-note.description: Authored engagement memory compiled as Memory nodes. Tracker records remain in their declared JSON authorities; frontmatter migration requires an explicit adapter.

session.description: A meeting/recording and its analyses (PlanOpticon pipeline). A record of what happened: append-only, never retuned.

activity-event.description: An activity event derived from a producer log; retention and refresh policy belong to its source. The default homepage feed is a rolling Git projection.

organization.description: A register entry for an organization (client, partner, vendor, the owner itself): the scope-level entity table that lets two brains name the same company without merging their data. Stakeholders affiliate to it; equivalences across brains resolve to it. Authored and reviewed, never extracted.

contains.description: Hierarchy: phase contains epic contains feature contains story; group contains member.

owns.description: A stakeholder owns a decision, question, deliverable, or work node.

escalates_to.description: Reserved (#55): a fast-tier signal (open question, RAID item) raised against a slow-tier target.

affiliated_with.description: Membership in an organization: a person (stakeholder) is affiliated with an Organization register entry. Populated from stakeholder.org when a matching organization exists; a name matching no register entry emits nothing.

raised_in.description: A question or action was raised in a recorded session.

contextRecipes.$comment: Agent dispatch (#55 slice 1): a declared graph traversal that assembles a work node's task pack — context assembly is a traversal, not a grep. Keyed by the compiled brain node's `kind` field (Story, ActionItem, ...); `default` covers any kind with no override. scripts/gen-task-pack.py walks each hop's rel/direction from the task node (or transitively, repeating the hop until nothing new resolves) and assembles the result under the hop's `as` key.

generators.$comment: What `make build` runs for a brain composing this layer (scripts/build_plan.py, #202). `make` lists build targets; `stage` orders them across layers (ties keep layer, then list, order); `artifacts` are the deterministic outputs the drift gate (GENERATED) compares. `brain` names the gen-brain.py adapters this layer's records feed.
